_how: The HUD news line (assets/ticker.js). headlines: short news lines (at most about 60 characters, no technical detail) about what is new on the testnet and the site, newest and most important first; every headline carries since (the day it went on the line, YYYY-MM-DD) and leaves the line days (below, 14) days later, or keep: true for a standing pointer that stays (use it sparingly: the line is for news); a headline with until (an ISO time in UTC) leaves the line at that time; mode live shows a headline only on the real chain, mode sim only in the simulation, no mode in both; mark ghost puts the chain core's ghost symbol in front and the live ghost count in the text; tip: the short hover text with more context (at most about 140 characters, two lines); picks: our X posts worth reposting, {text, href} with href the post's x.com address; invites: Telegram and X. New features also come in by themselves from the "major" entries of assets/updates.json and leave days after their day; so do new blog articles; the next cruise ship comes in three days before it calls. infra/alerts/tickerwatch.py warns the owner privately when nothing new came onto the line for a week. move: per language, left (text enters on the right, the usual way) or right. Every text needs its zh and ja translation in assets/i18n/zh/hud.js and ja/hud.js, or it is left out on those pages. idni: news headlines about what IDNI lands on tau-testnet main come in by themselves for a week (node.tauhud.com/devpulse.json, written per merge by a language model in en, zh and ja); keyed by the first 7 letters of one of its commits, {text, tip} replaces one (zh and ja in hud.js), {skip: true} leaves it out.

headlines.text: Tau chess engine vs Claude Opus 5.5: 13 won, 5 drawn, 2 lost
headlines.tip: Twenty games on 1 November, ten at effort medium and ten at high, counted for the engine. An independent community project.

headlines.text: Rule challenge: a new task for your wallet every Monday
headlines.tip: Every Monday the Daily Consensus sets a small task. You answer it with a real rule in your test wallet.
Ghost transactions are already sealed in a block, but the node still lists them as waiting. A known testnet bug (IDNI #81).

headlines.text: Most network rule changes so far are tests that change nothing
headlines.tip: Most rule changes sent to the network so far were test traffic that left the rules as they were. Proposals shows each one.

headlines.text: Rules wall: every personal rule on the testnet
headlines.tip: Every personal rule accounts gave themselves on the testnet, read from the blocks, one card per rule in plain words.

headlines.text: My Tau card: your rules, votes and stamps on one card
headlines.tip: One picture of what your test wallet did on the testnet: rules written, votes, Agorzilla meals and café stamps.

headlines.text: Road to mainnet: what must be fixed first, as we see it
headlines.tip: What we found on the testnet that we think should be fixed before mainnet, each item with proof anyone can check.

headlines.text: Telegram alerts now follow any account or rule change
headlines.tip: Follow an account or an open rule change, and our Telegram bot writes to you when something happens.

headlines.text: Start here: try Tau in four steps
headlines.tip: Make a test wallet, give your account a rule every node checks, watch a block seal it, and feed Agorzilla.

headlines.text: The Daily Consensus: a new edition every Monday
headlines.tip: Our weekly paper about the testnet. Each language gets its edition on Monday at 09:00 in its own time.

headlines.text: Agorzilla: one creature the whole testnet feeds
headlines.tip: A creature that grows with the testnet: wallets feed it, and every evening visitors vote on how it grows.

headlines.text: Your limits hold in every wallet: rules bind the account
headlines.tip: A rule binds the account, not the app: every node checks each payment against it, whichever wallet signed it. Try rules in the Playground.

invites.tip: Our Telegram channel: rule changes, new nodes and a short digest of the testnet every day.
Our X account: rule changes, new nodes, the testnet each evening and a weekly review.
